messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Political behaviour and attitudes, Government, political systems and organisations, and Elections in Czech Republic during the 2000s, matching this research need: Monthly 2000 Czech public opinion survey data on party preferences, election participation and vote choice, trust in political leaders and institutions, democracy and EU attitudes, economic perceptions, religiosity, household living standard, region, and community size
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
